nodes.summary: Decide whether the request needs retrieval, graph context, or direct abstain.
Run dense Qdrant retrieval over source-linked chunks.
Check score and payload coverage before answer generation.
Rewrite low-confidence queries toward source names, route contracts, and service handles.
Optionally call rerank-api for neural reranking when the caller accepts load cost.
Answer through langchain-api with mandatory citations and abstain on insufficient context.
